services.cms: Node.js Docker runtime, single process on 127.0.0.1:1989
services.rateLimit: disabled for load-items and load-deliver to measure endpoint capacity

workloads.items: load-items.js, list ramp 1->50 VUs plus 10 VU detail and 30 VU create burst, 2m

notes: Postgres host port 55432 was used because an unrelated directus_postgres container already occupied host port 5432; the container service itself remains on 5432.
The generated JWT was passed through the shell only and is not stored in the repository.
Failed thresholds are retained as measurements, not replaced with estimates. load-deliver showed resource saturation under this single-process setup; see load-deliver.json.
